title: Implement and execute bounded metadata-only origin observation on Render
previous: BRAIN-N100 observed both declared HTTPS source pages but could not prove canonical identity or independence
scope: record requested host and final host
record HTTPS/TLS transport metadata where safely observable
do not download or parse source-truth payload
do not classify redirects as canonical identity
do not classify hostname difference as independence
completion_gate: Render runtime executes the probe and emits a compact non-secret origin receipt for both declared sources; canonical identity remains DENY unless an explicit proof contract is satisfied
